_about: Customer profiles, chosen before pricing a job (--customer, the Cura dropdown, "customer" in printtally.json, or default_customer in settings.json). They act on your price after the market cap and minimum order: discount_pct first, then min_per_g / max_per_g (Rs per gram of the job). The cost floor (min_margin) always wins. Add your own in ~/.config/printtally/customers.json or under "customers" in settings.json.

customer.description: Everyone else: your rate card price, never under Rs 20 per gram.

friends.description: Friends: the same price, kept under Rs 20 per gram (never under the cost floor).

none.description: No customer rules: the plain profile price (kits, wholesale, checks).
